With just ₹8.75 Crore left in the purse and Shahrukh Khan released, Gujarat Titans face a major middle-order dilemma heading into the TATA IPL 2027 Auction. Will GT use their stacked bench of Indian fast bowlers to pull off a blockbuster trade with a team like CSK?
In this video, experts Aakash Chopra, Abhinav Mukund & Anant Tyagi break down Gujarat Titans' retention, releases and auction strategy!
